title: Aliprantis's questions on locally solid topologies
summary: In 1974, C. D. Aliprantis posed several questions concerning topological completions of locally solid vector lattices. We answer all of them in the negative. We construct Hausdorff locally convex-solid vector lattices showing that, without metrizability, neither the $σ$-Lebesgue property nor property (B, i) need pass to the completion; a positive element of the completion need not be the limit of a decreasing sequence of upper elements; the generalized (A, 0) property need not make the canonical image a regular sublattice; and regularity of this image need not imply order density.
